stories.title: Gunman opens fire on police officer outside Ontario synagogue on Yom Kippur
stories.reason: A 29-year-old man fired roughly 30 shots at an officer guarding the Sons of Jacob Synagogue in Belleville during Yom Kippur services, critically wounding the 13-year police veteran before being shot himself, with the synagogue's president crediting the officer with saving everyone inside.

stories.title: Firefighting helicopter crashes near Yosemite, killing both pilots battling the Dome Fire
stories.reason: The Eurocopter AS332 went down while making water drops southeast of Ostrander Lake, killing two contract pilots and prompting NTSB and FAA investigations as roughly 580 personnel continue fighting the blaze, which is only 15% contained.

stories.title: CNN, MS NOW and Politico sue the Trump administration over their White House ban
stories.reason: The First Amendment lawsuit seeks an emergency court order restoring the outlets' access after Trump barred their reporters following a Truth Social post calling their coverage 'FAKE NEWS,' a move that has already led ABC, CBS, Fox and NBC to suspend joint pool coverage of the president in protest.

stories.title: Oil prices fall to an 11-day low as US-Iran diplomacy hopes and Saudi export recovery ease supply fears
stories.reason: Brent slid to $101.75 and WTI to $98.34 a barrel after Trump signaled openness to meeting Iran's president at the UN General Assembly, the clearest sign yet that the risk premium gripping energy markets since the war began may be starting to loosen.

stories.title: Iran's Pezeshkian departs for the UN General Assembly as Trump warns of 'no-deal' consequences
stories.reason: Pezeshkian will address world leaders in New York this week and hold sideline talks on ending the war with Washington, arriving just as Trump has threatened to let Iran 'rot economically' or move to eliminate its leadership if no agreement is reached.

stories.title: AMD's stock surges 10%, pushing its market value past $1 trillion for the first time
stories.reason: The milestone makes AMD the fourth US chipmaker to cross the trillion-dollar threshold after Nvidia, Broadcom and Micron, capping a nearly 30% monthly rally as investors bet heavily on its share of the AI data-center buildout.

stories.title: SoftBank launches a record $11 billion junk-bond sale to fund a deeper stake in OpenAI
stories.reason: The offering, split across dollar and euro tranches, would be the largest non-financial corporate bond deal ever from the Asia-Pacific region and pushes SoftBank's total OpenAI investment toward $64.6 billion for roughly a 13% stake, underscoring how much debt is now fueling the AI investment boom.

stories.title: Apple's new Mac mini and Mac Studio with M6 and M5 Pro/Max/Ultra chips begin shipping
stories.reason: The launch extends Apple's biggest product month of the year, following the iPhone 18 Pro, the foldable iPhone Duo and new Apple Watch and AirPods models, as the company pushes deeper into on-device AI performance across its Mac lineup.
